typeIds.reason: Code names are English (design T4 §2); the Portuguese names stay as the pt-BR label of each type.

typeOrder.source: G 61950 CATS order (the game indexes types by position)
typeOrder.reason: Same order as the game, so a type index means the same in both.

typeSpeeds.reason: P3: Bestiário base. For blind, charred, drowned and devourer the Bancada value is the `chase` state and the game/Bestiário chase speed is `frenzy`. Runner holds 5.5 m/s and sprints at 6.0.

drownedSpawn.reason: The game has weight 0, the Bestiário 1%. Default: weight 1, only near water.

childTypePool.reason: Children can turn into every type except brute and bloater. The `childTypePool` option replaces it.

woundNames.reason: Default is the game's three wound types ([share of wounds, chance to infect]); the Bestiário's scratch 20% is one line in infection.json.

ageIds.reason: English ids in the game's order.

agePerception.source: bestiario:2 age table (Percepção: base, base, audição −10%, visão −40% olfato −30%)
agePerception.reason: The game's IDADES has no perception; the Bestiário table adds it. Multipliers are fractions added to 1.

outfitIds.reason: English ids in the game's order.

protectionPresets.source: design T4 §2 damage pipeline step 2; G 61976 ROUPAS
protectionPresets.reason: Item ids are the ones game-items takes `protection.ballistic` for when Phase 3 merges. `blunt` is the vest's multiplier on pistol-class shots and `pass` on rifle-class (absent: same as `blunt`), exactly the game's `colete` pair.

lootPools.reason: Calibre ids become game-weapons calibre ids (556 -> 5_56x45).

calibreIds.reason: Maps the game's calibre keys to the SDK's, which the P7 calibration test reads.

poseIds.source: G 65500 iB comment (pose 0 anda/1 rasteja/2 caído/3 ataca/4 grito/5 agachado/6 salto/7 comendo)
poseIds.reason: English ids of the 8 game poses, in the game's index order.

segmentRegions.reason: A segment resolves to a region (the arm and leg ones by side).

elencoSegmentIds.reason: Elenco has 8 kinds; they map onto the Arsenal's 11 segments (the shin carries the foot).

severity.source: G 67011 zDamage; arsenal:979-992 damage; elenco:463 hit
severity.reason: Game and Elenco agree on cut >= 0.5 or damage > 0.9 of max; Arsenal destroys at damage >= 2x max and splits the torso at >= 150.

defaultCut.source: design T4 §2 step 6; elenco:461 WEAPONS cut
defaultCut.reason: Ballistic cut comes from the Elenco weapon table.

deathRule.reason: Game rule by default; the Elenco/Bestiário golden rule as an option.

proportions.reason: P1: the guide's proportions are the default; the game's narrower body is the TEAM_GAME preset the goldens use.

physicalPenetration.source: consolidado.md P7; design T4 §2 step 3; bestiario:2 (9 mm 2 bodies, 5.56 3, .308 4); G 68699 shootRay
physicalPenetration.reason: Force P = sqrt(E*m/A) in mm^2 against the resistance R of the path; the segment hit, then P -= R until P <= 0. Torso R = 22*0.25 + 2*1.0 = 7.5.

teamGamePenetration.reason: The game's pen points: each body costs by region and keeps 75% of the damage. Used only by the golden preset.

appearanceVariance.reason: The numbers zSpawn draws with; the G-spawn golden replays the game's own function.

moments.reason: Defaults of the moment multipliers; the game can replace each one. Night has none in the game.

leaper.evidence: Salta 6 m na horizontal e 3 m para cima

bloater.evidence: explode numa nuvem de 4 m: cega 5 s

stalker.evidence: Finge de morto entre os corpos

blind.evidence: Ouve tiros a 80 m e passos a 6 m

screamer.evidence: chama todos num raio de 150 m e dá +20% de velocidade por 30 s

charred.evidence: 3 de dano por segundo durante 4 s

devourer.evidence: cada um dá +20 de vida e +5% de tamanho, até 3 vezes

abilities.source: bestiario:6-46 Z ai text; G 67257 zSpecialSpawn, 67266 zAbility, 67053 inchadoBurst
abilities.reason: Movement abilities ship as data (game-crowd runs them in Phase 8). `evidence` is a snippet the source test finds in the Bestiário text of the type, so a changed source fails the check.

notPorted: Bestiário v0.1 builder (text and gait data only)

scope.source: design T4 §1, §2 content packs, consolidado.md P9
scope.reason: What goes where. The game slice is written by --game-out into specs/001-migracao-entregas-dos-times/game-slice/characters/ and copied to the zombiada repository.
